description: We are NASA-bbajim, a team of passionate student developers from Busan Software Meister High School in South Korea. We believe that great ideas are not defined by age or experience, but by curiosity, courage, and the willingness to challenge the impossible. We may be young, but we are not afraid to dream beyond our limits. Through teamwork, creativity, and relentless learning, we hope to prove that even students can make a meaningful impact on the future of space exploration.
